title: Layout File Management
description: Join between semantic graph and cosmetic layout.
body: The join between the semantic graph and the cosmetic layout file, in both directions: `buildDoc` opens a Schematic, `toLayoutFile` produces what a change persists. Groups and comments round-trip through the cosmetic file in full. PRD §6.1 already names groups as layout content, and PRD §11.3 puts both kinds in the annotation tier — out of reconciliation and unable to carry a semantic edge — so keeping them out of `nodes/` is what makes an annotation is not design data true on disk.
